from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set()
    regions=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while q:
          y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==0 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
        regions.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
      colors={grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if grid[r][c] not in (0,8)}
      if len(colors)!=1: continue
      color=next(iter(colors))
      pts=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if grid[r][c]==color]
      if not pts: continue
      pr0=min(r for r,c in pts); pr1=max(r for r,c in pts)
      pc0=min(c for r,c in pts); pc1=max(c for r,c in pts)
      pat=[[grid[pr0+i][pc0+j] for j in range(pc1-pc0+1)] for i in range(pr1-pr0+1)]
      ph,pw=len(pat),len(pat[0])
      for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
          out[r][c]=pat[(r-pr0)%ph][(c-pc0)%pw]
    return out
